```artifact
## Decision Table Test Suite for U28_misc

| Condition | Action |
|---|---|
| Chemist/Lab Id exists | Display details, allow modification or deletion |
| Chemist/Lab Id doesn't exist | Display error message "Chemist or Lab does not exist" |
| Open prescriptions exist | Display error message "Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete" |
| Open prescriptions don't exist | Delete Chemist/Lab details successfully |
| Symptom Code exists | Display details, allow modification or deletion |
| Symptom Code doesn't exist | Display error message "Symptom does not exist" |
| Add new Symptom Code | Display success message "Symptom Code added successfully" |
| Update Symptom Code | Display success message "Symptom details updated successfully" |
| Confirmation message displayed | Confirm deletion of Chemist/Lab |

```
